WHAT HAPPENED: IDFC Limited (the holding company, NSE: IDFC / BSE 532659) was reverse-merged INTO its own subsidiary IDFC FIRST Bank. Not insolvency, not a rename, not a data gap. Scheme of amalgamation: IDFC Financial Holding Co merged into IDFC Ltd, then IDFC Ltd merged into IDFC FIRST Bank Ltd. NCLT approved in May 2024; the merger became effective 1 October 2024. Swap ratio: 155 equity shares of IDFC FIRST Bank (FV Rs 10) for every 100 equity shares of IDFC Ltd (FV Rs 10) = 1.55x. IDFC Ltd ceased to exist as a listed entity; every holder was automatically credited IDFCFIRSTB shares (record date ~10 Oct 2024 — that specific date is from recall, NOT fetch-verified, because nseindia.com/bseindia.com returned 403 and my WebSearch budget was already exhausted at session start).

PRIMARY EVIDENCE FROM OUR OWN DATA (nse.nse_bhavcopy_historical via CR API, the same survivorship-free source the backtest uses):
- IDFC last print 2024-10-08 close Rs 107.97 on 65.27M shares — 4-9x its normal 3-15M daily volume. Classic final cum-date before suspension. No IDFC row exists after that date; IDFCFIRSTB keeps printing uninterrupted.
- IDFCFIRSTB on the same 2024-10-08: close Rs 72.39, also a volume spike to 120.8M (vs ~20-50M normal) — the other leg of the same merger-arb unwind.
- Swap value check: 1.55 x 72.39 = Rs 112.20 vs IDFC's final Rs 107.97 => holder received 103.9% of the last IDFC print. On 5-day means (IDFC 109.30, IDFCFIRSTB 72.31): 1.55 x 72.31 = 112.08 => 102.5%. IDFC spent its last days at the normal ~3-4% merger-arb discount to swap value, so the holder came out marginally AHEAD of the last traded price, not behind. Hence recovery_value_pct = 104 (clamp to 100 if your convention caps at par).

THE NAIVE MARK IS WRONG: -20.9% is not right. Zero terminal loss here. This ticker ending is a relabelling-with-a-multiplier, not an impairment. The backtest should carry the position forward as 1.55 x IDFCFIRSTB from 2024-10-08 onward rather than realising any loss.

NUANCE (successor performance, not a terminal event): holders could not trade from 9 Oct until the IDFCFIRSTB shares were credited (roughly three weeks), and over that window IDFCFIRSTB slid 72.39 -> ~65.9 (Q2 FY25 microfinance provisioning). Follow-successor treatment captures that correctly as ordinary successor drawdown. Also note bhavcopy prices are UNADJUSTED, so any later IDFCFIRSTB corporate action still has to be handled by the consumer.

SOURCES: our own nse.nse_bhavcopy_historical (CR API) for all prices/volumes and the last-trade date; Wikipedia "IDFC First Bank" ("155 equity shares of the bank were allotted for every 100 equity shares of IDFC Limited held by each shareholder"; "On 1 October 2024, IDFC Limited merged with the bank"; "the merger proposal was approved by the National Company Law Tribunal in May 2024"); Wikipedia "IDFC" (same 155:100 ratio, 1 Oct 2024 effective, reverse merger); screener.in/company/IDFC page titled "IDFC Ltd (Merged)" frozen at 9 Oct 2024 / ~Rs 108 (the fetch summariser misread the frozen snapshot as "still listed" — the "(Merged)" title and the frozen date are the actual signal). NSE/BSE primary filings could not be fetched (403/404) and WebSearch was budget-exhausted for this session, so exchange notices are corroborated indirectly rather than quoted.

Reading it as UTC shifts every NSE date one day early and misaligns any join against FMP's correctly-dated series. Convert in Asia/Kolkata, never UTC. Indian amalgamations of this form are tax-neutral to the holder: no capital gain crystallised at the swap, cost basis and holding period carry over.

Sintex Industries Ltd (NSE SINTEX, BSE 502742) was wiped out in NCLT insolvency. Equity holders got NOTHING: no cash, no successor shares, no residual stub. THE NAIVE -92.3% MARK IS WRONG AND TOO GENEROUS - the correct mark is -100%, applied on the first bar after epoch 2022-03-20 from the last print of Rs 7.80.

Timeline: defaulted Jun-2019; admitted to CIRP Apr-2021 (Wikipedia). 19-Mar-2022 the CoC approved 100% the joint resolution plan of Reliance Industries + Assets Care & Reconstruction Enterprise (ACRE), which provided that "the existing share capital of the Company shall be reduced to zero" and the company be delisted (ibclawreporter.in, quoting the Company Secretary's statement to the exchanges). 21-Mar-2022 NSE circular CML51690 and a BSE circular suspended trading. 22-Mar-2022 trading ceased on both exchanges - Zerodha market-intel bulletin 318780 (22 Mar 2022): "The equity shares of Sintex Industries Limited (SINTEX) are delisted from today and shall not be available for trading w.e.f 22nd March 2022... The entire share capital of Sintex Industries Limited will be written off as part of the Insolvency resolution process. You will not be able to sell your holdings." NCLT Ahmedabad approved the plan by order dated 10-Feb-2023 (s.30(6)/s.31 IBC); BSE notice 03-Mar-2023 delisted the equity effective 10-Mar-2023 (in.marketscreener.com BSE notice 43151315); RIL completed the acquisition in Mar-2023 and holds ~70% with ACRE (Wikipedia). NCLAT, Titus Babu v. Sintex Industries, 30-Aug-2026: "the existing equity shares of Sintex were extinguished in their entirety"; the clean-slate principle bars reviving pre-resolution shareholder rights; a ~Rs 110 crore compensation claim on 1,35,000 shares was dismissed (sansalegal.com, business-standard, thehindubusinessline).

OUR OWN DATA (nse.nse_bhavcopy_historical, queried via CR prod 2026-10-10): SINTEX = 5,085 rows, 1998-11-04 to 2022-03-20, then nothing; no symbol variant matches '%SINTEX%'; absent entirely from nse.nse_charting_day. This is NOT a coverage gap - the table runs to 2026-03-24 with ~1,650 symbols/day across the Mar-2022 window. Last bar O=H=L=C=7.80 on volume 5,021,963, versus prior close 8.20 (8.20 x 0.95 = 7.79), i.e. a lower-circuit lock. Epoch convention check: the week's final session maps to the FOLLOWING Sunday (Fri 2022-03-25 appears as epoch 2022-03-27), so epoch 2022-03-20 is the 17/18-Mar-2022 session - the last one before the 22-Mar suspension. Our data stops exactly where the real ticker stopped.

Caveats, both immaterial to recovery=0: (a) screener.in shows a last price of Rs 2.30 "as of 10 Feb 2023" and a taxguru summary mentions share purchases running "to January 2023", hinting at some post-suspension activity (BSE, off-market, or a stale quote) - our NSE bhavcopy shows none, and the NSE ticker still ended 22-Mar-2022 with the equity ultimately cancelled. (b) Do not confuse this with the SEPARATE, EARLIER 2017 demerger of the plastics business into Sintex Plastics Technology Ltd (NSE SINTEXPLAST), a different company that was itself distressed; it is not the ticker-ending event here. Classification is insolvency, not demerger, not rename, not share swap.
